versions.changelog: Add taskops daemon supervisor with user-systemd install/start/status/logs/uninstall lifecycle.
TaskOps v0.5.3: harden queue runner stale lease recovery, attempt finalization, and timeout documentation.
Add queue-backed runner watch mode, retry attempt caps, OpenClaw chat progress reports, and stable dogfood smoke deadlines.
TaskOps v0.5.1: queue projection, queue-backed runner once, runner attempts, progress report ledger, and Node 22 queue runtime requirement.
Simple Honest Long-Run Loop: add taskops next, explain, and guarded close commands; reinforce TaskOps as a work-truth protocol for long-running AI agent work.
Runner dogfood improvements: snapshot extension, all_closed, unblock-check, blocker rechecks, and runner smoke coverage.
Sharpen README positioning across GitHub, npm, and ClawHub: TaskOps as an agentic execution control layer, with a smaller quick loop and AI-assisted refactor example.
Fix dry-run decomposition reuse when the child task group/version already exists; runner dispatch semantics from 0.4.2 retained.
Runner dispatches runnable, decomposition, exploration, blocked, and waiting semantics.
Patch release after v0.4.0: polish npm package README and metadata; TaskOps closure/delegation model unchanged.
Add work roots, explicit EoW closure nodes, delegated waiting run nodes, bidirectional task-run refs, and independent runs storage.
